lines.speaker: jinx
lines.text: I lost a match I thought I had solved. Go on, say something clever.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Would you rather talk about the game or leave it alone?

lines.speaker: jinx
lines.text: Huh. I expected you to pretend it did not matter. It does. I made a bad read.

lines.speaker: jinx
lines.text: If you ever want to look at that turn with me, I might even listen. No promises.

choices.label: We can study the board, no excuses.
choices.reply: Fine. Bring your sharpest notes. I need something better than sympathy.

choices.label: You do not owe me a replay of that loss.
choices.reply: Good. I wanted you to know anyway.
